joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.admission: native FCFS, cap256 in every arm
fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: native in every arm; original completion boundary retained
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: Only ready, unsubmitted LOAD jobs within the same native start_kv_transfers call may reorder. Original STORE/flush, in-flight FIFO, submission boundary, streams, buffers, references and completion/release paths retained. Unknown layout/spec or destination alias falls back as a whole batch.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.observations: Same recovery-order trace, native completion-finalize observer and multi-LOAD decision records in both arms; no extra CUDA query/synchronization.
fixed.arrival_sequence: same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals,EOS cap1024
fixed.B_LOAD_ORDER: only variable: native ready LOAD order or stable ascending exact copy bytes

plan.selection: Fixed native/short_load/short_load/native. short_load is the simple ordering hypothesis itself, not a separately claimed novel policy; no redundant third equivalent rule. No latency-based conditional expansion.
plan.scope: Test whether small ready LOADs behind larger same-direction FIFO jobs can reach an earlier existing completion observation and next output. Original natural-EOS1024 cap256 workload with previously observed recovery; not the zero-recovery mixed_turnover workload. Normal GPU/Host budgets; no pressure expansion. Actual outputs and transfer bytes must be reported, and event-level rough duration budgets are not counterfactual benefit evidence. GPU UNRUN.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Retained original package and model cache; native model runner/mixin/worker/scheduler/KV manager hashes match; private torch CPU imports passed with CUDA uninitialized.
deployment.comparison_scope: All four arms rerun on this GPU; no historical latencies used as controls.

plan.hypothesis_source: Natural native session-20261007-r01 cell00 jobs9793/9794:226MiB precedes18MiB, both miss first finalize; observed host submission duration of the large job478.679us versus small GPU elapsed344.064us leaves a conditional small-first window. The small request also has84ms ack-to-scheduled delay, so output gain is unproven.
plan.stop_rule: If task order changes without stable all-request end-to-end net benefit in both execution orders, do not extend the rule or tune a predictor; inspect whether downstream capacity merely absorbed the advancement. No new pressure scan.
